# Vendored SQLite 2.8.17

Public domain, from https://www.sqlite.org/sqlite-2.8.17.tar.gz.

- `*.c`, `*.h` from `src/` (library objects only; no shell, Tcl or tests).
- Generated by the upstream build (`./configure --enable-utf8`, then `make`):
  `parse.c`, `parse.h` (lemon), `opcodes.c`, `opcodes.h`, `sqlite.h`
  (from `sqlite.h.in`, UTF-8 encoding).
- `config.h` is written by `build.rs` (`SQLITE_PTR_SZ` per target).

Unication's pagers and PPS use SQLite 2.8.x with UTF-8 text; files are
format "SQLite 2.1".
